scope: Unchanged dry-cap witness. Eighteen q=0 trajectories; q=1 at levels 3/5 and q=2 at level 3, finest caller cadence. No fine-mesh q=2 certificate, wet evolution, terrain barriers, seasonal selection or calibration.

decision.scope: Main q=0 cohort compared with the retained incident-mobility stage; not a universal rejection of element integration.
decision.nextControl: Measure the same graph-edge contour observable on independently sampled reference depths before diagnosing state evolution or changing reconstruction.
decision.notDiagnosed: Observation error versus discrete evolution error has not yet been isolated. Fine-mesh q=2, smooth wet evolution, variable-bed hydraulics and physical calibration remain open.
